project.name: execs
project.summary: 0.1.8 is latest stable: PR #59 and the tag workflow published verified Windows/Linux installers and updater. All nine 0.1.8 milestone issues are Done; remaining cumulative validation and 0.2.0 work are tracked separately.

milestones.description:
Startup, updater state, accessibility and release validation.

Clear stale update offers ([RND-246](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-246/clear-stale-update-offers-when-a-later-check-reports-no-update>)), show fail-closed startup errors ([RND-290](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-290/show-an-actionable-startup-error-when-durable-maintenance-preflight>)), fix per-pane scroll/active-nav visibility ([RND-291](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-291/keep-each-settings-pane-at-a-predictable-scroll-position>)), meaningful text contrast ([RND-292](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-292/make-meaningful-helper-and-status-text-meet-minimum-contrast>)), and inaccurate player documentation ([RND-294](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-294/correct-installer-platform-and-casual-compatibility-claims-in-player>)). Complete the cumulative Windows/Linux/Steam Cloud/Casual gate ([RND-251](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-251/run-the-cumulative-windows-and-linux-functional-release-matrix-before>)), with realistic profile preservation and visible packaged startup evidence. The unbounded update download ([RND-288](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-288/time-out-stalled-updater-payload-downloads-and-release-the-update>)) leads in 0.1.5; this bucket inherits it.

Planning checkpoints are provisional, not release promises or a requirement to publish every numbered patch. Do not hold install, updater, data-loss or write-lock fixes for a theme/date. Combine or skip empty releases if useful. Prepare patches from the latest public maintenance baseline (currently v0.1.5), with no incompatible schema or new live write targets, and forward-port each fix to 0.2.0. User-facing fixes carry \[Unreleased\] notes in their implementation commit. Require relevant regression checks, Windows/Linux CI, previous-public-profile compatibility and signed installer/updater verification. This audit creates work; it does not implement, tag or publish it.

Selected profile-management minor plus a clearly labeled candidate pool.

Creator ZIP review/import ([RND-201](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-201/import-creator-cfgcustom-zips-with-a-themed-trust-review-and-real>)) shipped in the owner-assigned 0.1.6 patch and is inherited here. The remaining selected user-visible scope is safe profile deletion ([RND-213](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-213/delete-profiles-safely-from-the-profile-menu>)), and focused app settings ([RND-214](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-214/add-app-settings-for-updates-motion-install-location-and-support>)). Complete profile-preloader integration/migration ([RND-202](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-202/replace-shared-preloader-selections-with-the-target-profile-during>)/[RND-274](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-274/switch-local-only-particle-profiles-without-requiring-the-default-mod>) and the minor slice of [RND-248](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-248/prevent-removing-particle-source-mods-while-their-preloader-selections>)), single-HUD lifecycle ([RND-215](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-215/enforce-one-hud-per-profile-across-replacement-import-switch-and>)), and all maintenance fixes before the release gate [RND-208](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-208/validate-and-publish-020-after-the-functional-fixes-and-profile>).

At the owner's request, new capabilities and larger refactors are now organized here using the execs-candidate label. Candidate does not mean committed to this release. Existing expanded binds, sensitivity, rename/duplicate/uninstall, broader cfg provenance, viewmodel organization/Linux compilation, stock-HUD return, particle conflict review, sound browsing, launch status and storage work remain selectable. New ideas [RND-295](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-295/preview-profile-differences-before-switching>)–299 cover switch diffs, health/offline readiness, restore points, GameBanana file variants and cfg provenance; [RND-300](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-300/extract-settings-loading-and-mutation-coordination-from-settingshost>)–302 are focused internal refactors. Authenticode [RND-191](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-191/windows-code-signing-authenticode-for-the-installer-and-updater>) and comment cleanup [RND-204](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-204/trim-redundant-comments-across-panes-shared-ui-hooks-and-rust-commands>) are also uncommitted candidates with their prior work states preserved.

Choose or swap within at most three visible features, or one large feature for a whole minor. Defer unselected candidates to a later minor before freezing the release; do not call the milestone percentage a release-readiness score.

Planning checkpoints are provisional, not release promises or a requirement to publish every numbered patch. Do not hold install, updater, data-loss or write-lock fixes for a theme/date. Combine or skip empty releases if useful. Prepare patches from the latest public maintenance baseline (currently v0.1.6), with no incompatible schema or new live write targets, and forward-port each fix to 0.2.0. User-facing fixes carry \[Unreleased\] notes in their implementation commit. Require relevant regression checks, Windows/Linux CI, previous-public-profile compatibility and signed installer/updater verification. This audit creates work; it does not implement, tag or publish it.

September 17 owner planning update: [RND-228](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-228/rebuild-files-as-a-profile-aware-tf2-config-workspace-for-017>) is expanded into the Files workspace rework and moved to proposed 0.1.7 with [RND-313](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-313/give-files-an-editor-first-workspace-with-usable-navigation-and-core>)–323. It is no longer in this milestone's candidate pool. The bounded patch exception and [source-backed plan](<https://linear.app/rndaom/document/files-workspace-deep-audit-research-and-017-rework-plan-73e3e612b655>) are recorded in 0.1.7. [RND-299](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-299/explain-the-cfg-source-and-class-context-of-a-setting>) retains broader setting-pane provenance here; Files-local source context is [RND-322](<https://linear.app/rndaom/issue/RND-322/explain-files-ownership-execution-role-and-resolvable-cfg-links>). Existing selected minor scope is unchanged.

issues.title: Run the cumulative Windows and Linux functional release matrix before 0.2.0
Review GameBanana file variants before choosing a download
Make meaningful helper and status text meet minimum contrast
Keep each settings pane at a predictable scroll position
Show which particle mod wins each conflicting file before Apply
Audit execs Windows polling for periodic TF2 frame stalls
Replace shared preloader selections with the target profile during switching
Make the execs TF2 preload hook startup-safe
Explain the cfg source and class context of a setting
Validate and publish 0.2.0 after the functional fixes and profile-management scope
Preview profile differences before switching
Correct installer, platform and Casual compatibility claims in player documentation
Remove or restrict unused whole-backup gameinfo restoration helpers
Delete profiles safely from the profile menu
Show an actionable startup error when durable maintenance preflight fails
Extract settings loading and mutation coordination from SettingsHost
Enforce one HUD per profile across replacement, import, switch and absorb
Clear stale update offers when a later check reports no update
Switch local-only particle profiles without requiring the default mod library
Trim redundant comments across panes, shared UI, hooks, and Rust commands
Add app settings for updates, motion, install location and support
Windows code signing (Authenticode) for the installer and updater
Let Linux users build custom per-class viewmodel setups inside execs
Show local storage usage and safely clear rebuildable caches in Settings
Show whether profile launch options are copied, pending or saved to Steam
Add Return to stock HUD without changing the rest of the profile
Simplify Sounds browsing around the selected hit or kill sound
Add whole-profile viewmodel visibility presets with an exact change review
Bring visibility, FOV and transparent viewmodels together in Viewmodels
Duplicate any saved profile without switching it into the game
Rename profiles without rebuilding or copying their contents
Add a safe uninstall and leave-TF2-as-is flow in app settings
Add a curated Gameplay section for reload, healing and damage feedback
Add precise mouse and zoom sensitivity controls to Gameplay
Review bind conflicts and provide explicit clear and secondary-key actions
Expand Binds with combat, weapon, communication and menu actions
Keep serialized Rust records and TypeScript bridge types in sync
Add bounded local profile restore points with a change review
Show local installation health and offline readiness
